name: kinetic-universe
vibe: A cinematic prompt-to-video launch film set in a living cosmos. Deep-space near-black ground, drifting violet-and-cyan light beams, a perspective grid floor and a parallax starfield that flow unbroken across every cut. Kinetic gradient headlines that pop word-by-word, glowing screenshot device-frames that float in orbit, ignition rings, converging light streaks and a logo-reveal CTA. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole universe — beams, grids, glows, cards, chips and CTAs, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for AI/tech products, app launches, bold energetic hooks and anything that should feel vast and future-facing.
